config.label: Router address on the LAN, for example 192
config.description: Router address on the LAN, for example 192.168.1.1. Optional: `npx keenetic-mcp init` discovers it from the default gateway and stores it.

config.label: Router login
config.description: Router login. Optional, defaults to admin.

config.label: Router password
config.description: Router password. Optional: the setup wizard stores it in the operating system keychain instead. Use this in a container, where there is no keychain.
